title: The child waits for a signal
summary: A handler installed before fork is inherited by the child.
hints: Install the handler BEFORE `fork`: the child inherits it, so there is no moment in which `SIGUSR1` could still kill it.
Handler (child side): print `child: got SIGUSR1` with `write` and `exit(0)`. The parent: `kill(pid, SIGUSR1)`, `waitpid`, then print.
